  None of the available secondary literature passages in the dossier directly address Kv 12.2, as homonymous sections titled *Kammakathā* appear in Kathāvatthu Vagga XXI, in the *Atthasālinī*, and in non-Theravāda Abhidharma literature.

According to automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus, the *Kammakathā* shares 94 matching passages with 8 other Pali texts, but has no cross-language matches with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora that meet the reporting threshold [DharmaNexus]. Internally, it displays substantial text reuse with the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi*, particularly the *Dukanikkhepa* (Ds 2.3.2; 26 matches, 1029 characters, with the longest match across §6.1 ↔ §23.2 exhibiting 0.94 similarity) and the *Tikanikkhepa* (Ds 2.3.1; 9 matches, 393 characters) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares formulaic debate passages with several other chapters of the *Kathāvatthu*, including the *Kukkuḷakathā* (Kv 2.8; 14 matches), the *Vitakkānupatitakathā* (Kv 9.7; 12 matches), the *Dānakathā* (Kv 7.4; 11 matches), the *Saḷāyatanakathā* (Kv 12.4; 10 matches), the *Anāsavakathā* (Kv 4.3; 6 matches), and the cross-referenced *Rūpaṁkammantikathā* (Kv 8.9; 6 matches) [DharmaNexus].
